question: Will Celebrity Z publicly announce a breakup with their partner before September 30, 2026?
description: This market resolves based on a public statement by Celebrity Z or their verified representatives, on any platform, announcing the end of their current relationship.
resolutionRules: Resolves YES if, before 23:59 ET on 2026-09-30, Celebrity Z or their verified representative publicly announces the end of the relationship. Third-party reporting without confirmation from Celebrity Z does not count. Resolves NO otherwise.
